verdict.rationale:
LiveKit Agents has full documented support for LLM tool/function calling (custom Python/Node functions calling external APIs mid-conversation) plus MCP server tool integration, combined with adaptive interruption handling and turn-detection to avoid awkward dead air while tools execute. Runtime probes confirm the framework is real and installable, corroborating the docs claims.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence specifically showing tool-call latency handled gracefully in a live conversation (only vendor docs cover this exact combination).
